**What happened?**
A clear description of the problem.

**What did you expect?**

**When does it happen?**
- During a scan / after stopping / on startup / in a specific tab

**Your machine (optional but helps)**
- CPU / GPU / RAM / Windows version
- GameLoop running? PUBG Mobile running?

**Log file**
Attach `%LOCALAPPDATA%\LagHunter\logs\laghunter-<date>.log`, it usually tells us everything.
